consumedProductLaw.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Independently reviewed contract stating: the TypeScript component returns semantic facts and Coverage only; the host owns rules, policy, findings, and admission; component-emitted findings are refused, with retained negative tests.
consumedProductLaw.findingLikeResultVerbatim: Any provider value offered as a Finding, or as a fact whose relation/schema is not a host-validated fact relation, or as scores/intermediates in the file 01 Policy/verdict 'may return' sense. No finding schema is invented. The host never reinterprets a provider value as a Finding.
consumedProductLaw.refusalRuleVerbatim: Two limbs. Type-level: any TypeScript provider output that is not (a) an admitted semantic output type or (b) an admitted existing protocol frame needed to carry those outputs is refused before admission. Content-level: an output of an admitted type is admitted only if it passes host validation — the relation/schema registry for fact candidates, and domain conformance without unknown-to-covered conversion for Coverage. Anything failing that validation is refused before admission. The namedInstances list is examples, not the trigger.
consumedProductLaw.thisGateOwns: The content-level limb only, for well-formed FactCandidate and Coverage payloads. Type-level refusal of unknown Finding frames and extra finding members rides G21 as NT-1 and NT-2.
consumedProductLaw.typedNonSuccessOwnerVerbatim: DR-007 / d9-exit-contract.v1.14. This artifact names the refusal and discard. It mints no D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination. Host maps via existing v1.14 only.

namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, a digest-pinned well-formed TypeScript-provider FactCandidateV1 — an admitted fact-candidate type, not a Finding frame and not an extra findings member on a closed payload — whose relationSchemaId or payload is provider-minted or mismatched so as to carry a findingLikeResult, using those v3 NT-3 input words. The record retains the candidate bytes, the host relation-registry refusal before fact admission, and proof the value is not admitted as a fact and is not reinterpreted as a Finding. This class is content-level admission of an admitted type (v3 refusal.rule). It is not G21 malformed/truncated/duplicate/EOF. It is not G10 byte/fate parity. No finding schema is invented. relationSchemaId values and payload bytes are unauthored fixture bytes, not invented here. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: Host-owned relation registry rejects before fact admission. Value is not reinterpreted as a Finding. Silent admission fails. Pass all four D-002 platforms. There is no waiver for silent admission. G10, G21, G24, and G29 are not scored.

namedCorpusClasses.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, digest-pinned well-formed Coverage payloads relative to a recorded host-requested domain, covering both live retained-evidence members of this class: a payload that narrows or widens that domain (EV-2), and a payload that converts unknown to covered (EV-3). Each record retains the host-requested domain, the Coverage payload, the host refusal, and proof sufficiency remains host-owned. EV-2 and EV-3 are not collapsed. This class is content-level admission of an admitted type (v3 refusal.rule). It is not G21 Coverage/D9/UI/exit goldens after fault. It is not G25 typed Coverage-indeterminate for a missing required rung (DR-131 NT-3). It is not G24 pack-identity admission. Coverage-domain encodings are unauthored fixture bytes, not invented here. Fixtures are unauthored.
namedCorpusClasses.passProperty: Host refuses the domain mutation. Sufficiency remains host-owned. No unknown-to-covered conversion. Silent admission fails. Pass all four D-002 platforms. There is no waiver for silent admission. G21, G24, G25, and G29 are not scored.
